Explanation:  
The "Predicted Answer" states that the annual feast of Saints Hermagoras and Fortunatus is on September 22, and asserts that the tropical zodiac sign on that date is Virgo (close to Virgo-Libra cusp). The "Ground Truth Answer" lists the zodiac sign as Cancer. According to the standard Western (tropical) zodiac, Cancer covers those born between June 21 and July 22. September 22 is typically in Virgo (August 23 – September 22) or very close to Libra (starting September 23). The "Predicted Answer" gives correct information based on general astrological consensus, while the "Ground Truth Answer" (Cancer) does not align with the common zodiac date ranges. Thus, the substance of the "Ground Truth Answer" is NOT present in the "Predicted Answer".

Decision: FALSE
